name: sandpack
description: Monorepo for the forked Sandpack stack: transpiler, sandpack-client, bundler, and the sandpack-cdn Rust sidecar. One build, one config-driven deploy.

scripts.build: bun run build:transpiler && bun run build:client && bun run build:bundler && bun run build:cdn
scripts.build-and-deploy: bun run build && bun run deploy
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/transpiler run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/sandpack-bundler run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/sandpack-bundler run test && npm --prefix packages/transpiler run test
